message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

The sage sofa fits the room’s earthy palette, but the supplied scene doesn’t show the floor’s colour or material, so I can’t confirm that pairing specifically.

Warm ivory walls and a sandy beige rug soften the sage; walnut and oak tones add warmth, while terracotta and brass provide gentle accents. If the floor is warm wood or a neutral beige, the sofa should complement it well.

One optional small improvement: a slightly lighter cream rug colour could give the sofa more definition. Nothing has been changed.
